title: Concept: Java version disclosed in a response
description: A Java runtime version in an error message in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The runtime version tells an attacker which JVM advisories apply, and the same page usually names the application server as well.
applicability: Deployments that render a Java runtime version in an error message into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The runtime version tells an attacker which JVM advisories apply, and the same page usually names the application server as well.
